offering_description.value: UniFirst rents and sells uniforms and workwear to businesses and public agencies. It manufactures much of its workwear and uses local service routes to pick up, launder and replace garments and replenish facility and first aid supplies. It also launders cleanroom garments and decontaminates workwear for nuclear facilities.

primary_products.value: Uniforms and workwear; floor mats and shop towels; restroom supplies; first aid kits and supplies; personal protective equipment

primary_services.value: Uniform rental and laundering; mat and towel rental; facility and first aid supply replenishment; nuclear garment decontamination; cleanroom garment laundering

customer_segment.value: B2B: Manufacturers, food processors, restaurants, healthcare facilities, auto shops and nuclear plant operators; B2G: Municipal departments and other public agencies with uniformed staff

end_markets.value: Manufacturing; food processing and food service; automotive service; healthcare; nuclear power

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Recurring uniform, mat and towel rentals with scheduled pickup, laundering and delivery; product sales: Outright purchases of workwear, facility supplies and first aid and safety products; service fees: Garment decontamination, cleanroom laundering and first aid cabinet servicing
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Collects, cleans and returns workwear and restocks workplace supplies for employers; OEM / manufacturer: Turns textiles into workwear for business and public-sector customers; distributor: Sources and delivers restroom, first aid and safety supplies to workplaces

geography_served.value: global: Uniform services in the United States and Canada, specialty garment services in Europe, and manufacturing in Mexico and Nicaragua

specialization.value: related lines: Uniform rental and sales, facility supplies, first aid and safety, and specialty garment processing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Local sales teams, national account representatives and company-operated pickup and delivery routes

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Nuclear garment decontamination requires radioactive-materials licensing, and industrial laundries face wastewater discharge and workplace safety rules.
